title: Mabel
subtitle: Ghosts, family secrets, and intimate audio that makes the house itself feel like a voice.
description: A fiction podcast about ghosts, hidden histories, and missed connections, told through intimate messages and a steadily deepening sense of the uncanny.

length.label: Apple lists 50 episodes for the original fiction run.

archiveTake: A good match when the listener wants quieter supernatural unease and strong voice-driven atmosphere.

similarReasons.unwell: A warmer small-town branch if you want the haunting to keep its affection.
similarReasons.mirrors: Pushes the eeriness broader and stranger once the appetite turns more speculative.
similarReasons.alice-isnt-dead: Keeps the voice-driven dread alive while swapping ghosts for a road-haunted conspiracy pulse.
